groups.name: fopost
groups.description: Settings for the FoPost API client and the inbound webhook endpoint.

groups.name: fopost.webhook
groups.description: The endpoint this application exposes for FoPost webhook deliveries.

properties.name: fopost.api-key
properties.description: API key from fopost.com/dashboard/api-keys. Sent as the X-API-Key header. No FoPost bean is registered until this is set.

properties.name: fopost.base-url
properties.description: API root. A host with no path gets the versioned API path appended for you.

properties.name: fopost.timeout
properties.description: How long a single request may take before it gives up.

properties.name: fopost.max-retries
properties.description: Total attempts for a rate limited request, so 3 means two retries.

properties.name: fopost.default-workspace-id
properties.description: Workspace your own code should fall back to when a caller does not name one. The starter never sends it for you.

properties.name: fopost.webhook-secret
properties.description: Signing secret of the webhook endpoint, returned once by the create call. Required when fopost.webhook.enabled is true.

properties.name: fopost.webhook.enabled
properties.description: Whether to map a controller that receives FoPost webhook deliveries.

properties.name: fopost.webhook.path
properties.description: Path the webhook controller is mapped to.

properties.name: management.health.fopost.enabled
properties.description: Whether to contribute a 'fopost' entry to the actuator health endpoint.
